I am a **PhD Researcher and Research Assistant in Plant & AgriBiosciences at the University of Galway's Ryan Institute**.

My research asks how national agricultural, climate and land-use objectives translate into different costs, opportunities and constraints across farms, production systems and places.

</div>
</div>

## Research

My current work combines spatial, economic and behavioural modelling of agricultural and land-use transitions.

The main projects are **GOBLIN-Spatial**, **BioLand-US**, **E-SEAT** and **IFT-BioSim**.

## Methods

I work with econometrics, spatial modelling, optimisation, synthetic populations and microsimulation using Python, R, Stata, GIS and SQL.

## Background

I hold an **MSc in Management Science and Engineering** and currently undertake doctoral research at the University of Galway.
